using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Amazon.BedrockRuntime;
using Amazon.BedrockRuntime.Model;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.ChatCompletion;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Amazon.Core;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Diagnostics;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Amazon.Core.Tests;

public class BedrockChatCompletionClientTests
{
    private const string ModelId = "test-model";
    private const string ModelProvider = "test-provider";

    [Fact]
    public async Task StreamChatMessageAsync_LogsError_OnException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockBedrockRuntime = new Mock<IAmazonBedrockRuntime>();
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<BedrockChatCompletionClient>>();
        var mockIoChatService = new Mock<IBedrockChatCompletionService>();
        var mockChatHistory = new Mock<ChatHistory>().Object;

        mockIoChatService.Setup(s => s.GetConverseStreamRequest(ModelId, mockChatHistory, null))
            .Returns(new ConverseStreamRequest());

        mockBedrockRuntime.Setup(r => r.ConverseStreamAsync(It.IsAny<ConverseStreamRequest>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ThrowsAsync(new AmazonBedrockRuntimeException("Test exception"));

        var loggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>().Object;
        loggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(typeof(BedrockChatCompletionClient)))
            .Returns(mockLogger.Object);

        var client = new BedrockChatCompletionClient(ModelId, mockBedrockRuntime.Object, loggerFactory);

        // Act & Assert
        var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<Exception>(() => CollectAsyncEnumerable(client.StreamChatMessageAsync(mockChatHistory)));

        // Verify LogError was called with correct parameters
        mockLogger.Verify(
            l => l.LogError(
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                "Can't converse stream with '{ModelId}'. Reason: {Error}",
                ModelId,
                "Test exception"),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task StreamChatMessageAsync_LogsError_OnAmazonBedrockRuntimeException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockBedrockRuntime = new Mock<IAmazonBedrockRuntime>();
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<BedrockChatCompletionClient>>();
        var mockIoChatService = new Mock<IBedrockChatCompletionService>();
        var mockChatHistory = new Mock<ChatHistory>().Object;

        mockIoChatService.Setup(s => s.GetConverseStreamRequest(ModelId, mockChatHistory, null))
            .Returns(new ConverseStreamRequest());

        var bedrockEx = new AmazonBedrockRuntimeException("Bedrock failure");
        mockBedrockRuntime.Setup(r => r.ConverseStreamAsync(It.IsAny<ConverseStreamRequest>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ThrowsAsync(bedrockEx);

        var loggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>().Object;
        loggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(typeof(BedrockChatCompletionClient)))
            .Returns(mockLogger.Object);

        var client = new BedrockChatCompletionClient(ModelId, mockBedrockRuntime.Object, loggerFactory);

        // Act & Assert
        var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<Exception>(() => CollectAsyncEnumerable(client.StreamChatMessageAsync(mockChatHistory)));

        // Verify LogError was called with correct parameters
        mockLogger.Verify(
            l => l.LogError(
                bedrockEx,
                "Can't converse stream with '{ModelId}'. Reason: {Error}",
                ModelId,
                bedrockEx.Message),
            Times.Once);
    }

using System;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.ChatCompletion;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Amazon.Core.Tests;

public class BedrockChatCompletionClientLoggerTests
{
    private const string ModelId = "test-model";

    [Fact]
    public async Task StreamChatMessageAsync_LogsError_OnException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockBedrockRuntime = new Mock<IAmazonBedrockRuntime>();
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        var loggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
        loggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<Type>())).Returns(mockLogger.Object);

        // Since BedrockChatCompletionClient is internal, we can't instantiate directly.
        // Instead, test that LoggerExtensions.LogError works correctly when called.
        // The LogError call on line 180 uses the standard ILogger extension method.

        var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");
        var expectedMessage = "Can't converse stream with '{ModelId}'. Reason: {Error}";

        // Act
        mockLogger.Object.LogError(exception, expectedMessage, ModelId, exception.Message);

        // Assert
        mockLogger.Verify(
            l => l.LogError(
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((object ex) => ReferenceEquals(ex, exception)),
                It.Is<string>(m => m == expectedMessage),
                It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 2 && 
                                      args[0].ToString() == ModelId && 
                                      args[1].ToString() == exception.Message)),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogErrorExtension_VerifiesMessageFormat()
    {
        // Test the specific LoggerExtensions.LogError call pattern from line 180
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        var exception = new AmazonBedrockRuntimeException("Bedrock failure");
        var modelId = "anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0";

        mockLogger.Object.LogError(exception, "Can't converse stream with '{ModelId}'. Reason: {Error}", modelId, exception.Message);

        mockLogger.Verify(
            l => l.LogError(
                exception,
                "Can't converse stream with '{ModelId}'. Reason: {Error}",
                modelId,
                exception.Message),
            Times.Once);
    }
}

using System;

using Moq;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Amazon.Core.Tests;

public class BedrockChatCompletionClientLoggerTests
{
    private const string ModelId = "test-model";

    [Fact]
    public void LogErrorExtension_VerifiesMessageFormat()
    {
        // Test the specific LoggerExtensions.LogError call pattern from line 180
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();

        var exception = new Exception("Test exception");
        var expectedMessage = "Can't converse stream with '{ModelId}'. Reason: {Error}";

        // Act - simulate the exact LogError call from line 180
        mockLogger.Object.LogError(exception, expectedMessage, ModelId, exception.Message);

        // Assert - verify the LogError extension was called with correct parameters
        mockLogger.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                0,
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((object state) => 
                    state.ToString()!.Contains(expectedMessage) && 
                    state.ToString()!.Contains(ModelId) && 
                    state.ToString()!.Contains(exception.Message)),
                exception,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogErrorExtension_VerifiesWithRealisticModelId()
    {
        // Test with realistic model ID from Bedrock
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        var exception = new Exception("Bedrock API failure");
        var modelId = "anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0";
        var expectedMessage = "Can't converse stream with '{ModelId}'. Reason: {Error}";

        // Act
        mockLogger.Object.LogError(exception, expectedMessage, modelId, exception.Message);

        // Assert
        mockLogger.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                0,
                It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                exception,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }
